title: Playboy December 1973 Barbi Benton,  Christine Maddox, Vargas Girl, Christmas
descriptionText: The product is the December 1973 issue of Playboy magazine featuring Barbi Benton, Christine Maddox, and the Vargas Girl. This illustrated magazine, published in the United States, focuses on a holiday genre and is written in English. With a monthly publication frequency, Playboy offers its readers a mix of entertainment, lifestyle, and provocative content, making it a popular and iconic publication in the world of magazines.
